text:
incident-bot: Pager: High 95th-percentile latency observed on /v1/generate; auto-mitigation kicked (reroute to fallback model). Incident lasted ~22m. Link: https://redwood.inc/incident/INC-2026-042
alex: Oncall here — quick notes: we rerouted traffic at 10:03 UTC, rollback to scheduler change at 10:15, final mitigation at 10:25. Requesting postmortem kickoff and owner for RCA writeup.
maria: Putting together customer impact — preliminary: 182 requests with latency > 3s, 24 customers had >10% error spikes. I'll compile per-tenant list, ETA EOD.
devon: Draft timeline + probable contributing factors below. Sharing a working doc: https://confluence.redwood/pm/INC-2026-042

```
10:00 UTC - deploy of scheduler tweak (autoscale tweak).
10:02 UTC - spike in queue length and CPU on frontend pool.
10:03 UTC - alert fired; traffic rerouted to fallback model.
10:05 UTC - cache misses rose ~4x (suspect cache eviction policy)
10:12 UTC - partial rollback of scheduler config (test group)
10:15 UTC - full rollback
10:25 UTC - traffic back to normal; latency stabilized
```

devon: Preliminary contributing factors: 1) Scheduler change reduced pre-warming leading to burst overloads. 2) Cache eviction bug + KV cache invalidation under certain parallelism. 3) Fallback model has different tokenization which caused transient higher error rates for a subset of prompts.

devon: Draft action items (owners + ETA):
- A1: Add pre-deploy canary for scheduler tweaks (owner: alex, ETA: 2026-03-05)
- A2: Fix cache eviction race (owner: mike, ETA: 2026-02-28)
- A3: Add per-model tokenization compatibility checks for fallback (owner: jess, ETA: 2026-03-10)
- A4: Post-incident customer impact summary + comms draft (owner: maria, ETA: 2026-02-26)

mike: Logs snippet that looks relevant:
```
runner.cpp:line 412: KVCache::evict(): entry_count=1024 threshold=1024 -> evict triggered during parallel insert
scheduler.cpp:line 88: prewarm_count=2 requested=8 -> dropped prewarm request
```
mike: I can take A2, will open a PR and tag reviewers.
jess: I can own A3. Noted the tokenization mismatch for zh- and de- locales. I'll add unit tests.
lisa: Legal - please include the customer list + any high-severity tenant contacts before we send comms. @maria ensure PII sanitized.
ops-bot: Postmortem doc created: https://confluence.redwood/pm/INC-2026-042/postmortem (auto)
alex: Requesting peer reviewers: @devex, @platform, @sre. Please confirm review by 2026-02-27 so we can sign off and circulate.
maria: Will draft impact summary and do per-tenant checks. I'll ping for review when done.
jess: I'll review the RCA for technical accuracy; @mike please link PRs in the doc.
devon: Please add a short blameless root-cause statement and a timeline of evidence references. Once we have reviewer ack, I'll merge and request sign-off.
alex: Sign-off checklist: timeline + logs attached, action owners assigned, customer impact summary, mitigation review, and comms draft. Anyone opposed to me tagging this for exec review on Mon morning? :eyes:
mike: LGTM from SRE side. I'll include test coverage in the PR.
maria: OK from CS, will attach customer list (sanitized) and earliest outreach draft.
lisa: Legal acked for review, will check comms language.
ops-bot: Reminder: RCA owner metadata required: owner=devon, reviewers=[jess,mike,maria,lisa], signoff_deadline=1765433780
alex: Thanks all — assigning devon as RCA owner. If we can get reviewer acks by EOD tomorrow we can ship comms early next week. :thumbsup:
